accounting: Command selection; component counts are kept in distinct units.
MAC_definition: One multiplication and accumulation in a dense or attention matrix product.
common_exclusions: external robot and DC-link simulation propagation
regularization: Within each architecture, PR and SUP have identical network parameter and matrix-operation counts per forward evaluation.

RG_0_and_RG_P.N_eval: All candidate intervals evaluated, including continuation and refinement; state dependent.

Bus_PTP_beam.prediction_steps: W_P = sum_e sum_j n_ej, n_ej <= N_h
Bus_PTP_beam.J_e: Number of policy intervals predicted to cross or reject candidate edge e.
Bus_PTP_beam.scope: One complete plan; online schedule application is separate.

interpretation: Bounds are not observed mean counts. Counts of different primitives are not summed into FLOPs or a speed ratio. Physical admission remains active for all methods.
